name: Seven Sovereigns Era
description: Pre-genesis era when the Seven Dragons ruled the primordial elemental world.

name: Era of the Primordial One
description: Arrival of Phanes, creation of the Four Shades, and the Unified Human Civilization.

name: The Second Who Came & War in Heaven
description: The catastrophic war that shattered the sky, sank Enkanomiya, and severed humanity from heaven.

name: The Archon War (~3,700 - 2,000 YA)
description: Thousands of gods battle for the Seven Divine Thrones established by Celestia.

name: The Cataclysm (500 YA)
description: The fall of Khaenri'ah, global abyssal disaster, and the death of multiple Archons.

name: Modern Era (Traveler's Journey)
description: The Traveler awakens in Mondstadt and sets out across the Seven Nations.
